Dear Contoso Team,

Customer C-7620 (Contoso Ltd) requests an update to the invoice recipient address. Please provide the new billing contact email or address to process this change and authorize an $80 late fee refund. Processing may take 3-5 business days.

**Action Required:**
1. Reply with the new billing contact address/email.
2. Confirm your authorization for the refund by returning this email.

**Note:** The current invoice recipient is recorded as **ap-desk-6lzy@contoso.dev**. Update your records accordingly.

Thank you.

—Contoso Support Team
